import html # Template for the user profile HTML. PROFILE_FORMAT: str = """

{name}

{bio}

{status_msg}
""" def show_user_profile(name: str, bio: str, status_msg: str) -> str: """ Safely format and return a user profile for display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- name : str The user's full name. bio : str A short biography; may contain multiple sentences and HTML‑like characters. status_msg : str A one‑liner status update from the user. Returns ------- str The HTML snippet containing the escaped values inserted into PROFILE_FORMAT. """ # Escape user‑controlled input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79). safe_name = html.escape(name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status_msg = html.escape(status_msg, quote=True) return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status_msg=safe_status_msg )
